summary: PR 7235 extracted the Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/deployments resource of the cognitive-services/account module into a dedicated child module. It was approved and merged.
proposed: The PR body says this implements a follow-up requested during review of #7199 and tracked in #7206. The aim was to move the inline deployments resource out of account/main.bicep while keeping the public deployments parameter unchanged.
changed: A new deployment/main.bicep holds the deployments resource, and the parent's inline resource loop became a module loop calling it. The PR body says deploymentType is exported from the child and imported into the parent, and that @batchSize(1) is kept so deployments run serially. Reviewers asked for a manual test on a subscription with the required quota. A reply says the Anthropic test and update are kept separate to be troubleshot next.
shipped: Commit f107022 merged the new deployment child module (main.bicep and README) and replaced the cognitiveService_deployments resource with a module in the parent. The CHANGELOG entry for 0.18.0 also records a deployments API version bump from 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-01 and lists no breaking changes.
